articles.title: How this app differs from a tracker
articles.summary: Bodybuilder is a planner more than a diary. It decides what you should eat and lift next, and it reshapes that plan as your week shifts.

articles.title: Tools you need
articles.summary: Three things make the plan work: a gram food scale, a bathroom scale and a gym. All three make the plan's numbers more accurate.

articles.title: Weighing in
articles.summary: Weigh in often, and judge by the trend rather than any single day. Trend weight is behind nearly every decision the app makes.

articles.title: Reps in reserve (RIR)
articles.summary: RIR stands for reps in reserve, meaning how many good reps you had left when a set ended. The target falls over the block, so every week asks slightly more effort than the one before.

articles.title: Training on a cut
articles.summary: The aim during a cut is holding onto muscle and strength while fat drops. Keep training hard and raise the load gradually. Doing less isn't the answer.
